title: Steps to Protect from Ebola While You Wait for Help | Ebola | CDC
content: May 11, 2024 Steps to Protect from Ebola While You Wait for Help What to know This 14-page color flipbook explains what to do while you wait for help if someone is sick with Ebola disease. Download the printable PDF, available in English and French. This document is intended for communities outside of the U.S. Format: PDF Dimensions: 8.5x11 Page count: 14 Language: English (US) Size: 2 MB Length: Last updated: May 11, 2024 View Download View Larger Additional languages Steps to Protect from Ebola While You Wait for Help (French) booklet describing how to stay safe while waiting for care during an Ebola outbreak Download Download May 11, 2024 Sources Print Share Facebook LinkedIn Twitter Syndicate Content Source: National Center for Emerging and Zoonotic Infectious Diseases (NCEZID)
